Complimentary Airport Transfers – Terms and Conditions
A fee of AED 50 will be charged to the customer beyond a waiting period of 20 minutes.
A fee of up to AED 335 (excluding VAT) will be charged on the Covered Card if the minimum spend criteria is not met in a calendar month
There will be an authorization transaction of AED 2 for every access on the eligible Covered Card which will be automatically reversed after successful validation of the card.
Usage of the complimentary service by Supplementary Cardholder will be counted towards the total eligibility of 2 per annum on Emirates Skywards DIB Signature card.

The benefit is complimentary subject to the purchase of an Emirates Airline ticket using the Emirates Skywards DIB Signature card within 6 months prior to availing the airport transfer benefit and maintaining minimum monthly spends of AED 5,000
Airport lounge access: Enjoy complimentary access to over 1,200 airport lounges 8 times per year.
1st Visit to the airport lounge in a calendar year is complimentary.

To utilize the subsequent complimentary visits in the same calendar year, spend criteria of foreign currency spend of USD 1 equivalent must be met on a merchant that is located outside UAE, on both primary & supplementary cards minimum 15 days prior to the lounge visit. If the spend criteria is not met, a charge of US $32 per usage will be levied to the card used for the lounge visit.

Starting October 1, 2024, you just need to use the Visa Airport Companion App for complimentary access to airport lounges. The app will replace the process of showing your Card for lounge access. Click here for more details.
Easy Payment Plan with Emirates: Enjoy 0% Easy Payment Plan when you purchase Emirates tickets to any destination on emirates.com
Complimentary Travel Coverage: Enjoy travel and medical coverage of up to US$500,000 on your trips while booking your tickets with your card.

Experience Luxury Hotel Collection from Visa: Enjoy exclusive member privileges at over 900 luxury hotel properties around the world with preferential prices, room upgrades, free internet and breakfast, VIP guest status, late check-outs and complimentary food and beverage vouchers worth US$ 25.
Complimentary Valet Parking**: Take away the hassle of parking with 2 complimentary valet parking services per month at 18 key locations across the UAE.
